findings.problem: The reviewed-bundle v1 schema carries a list of sources but cannot bind a precise field/assertion to the source, derivation or editorial inference that supports it. This loses auditability when exact date/place/classification comes from different sources or a deterministic curator derivation.
required_semantics: subject/predicate or stable assertion target path
source_locator or source-relative expression where useful
optional derivation note without storing person identity
findings.candidate_implementation: Add an optional canonical assertion/provenance layer referenced by reviewed bundles or compile an attested assertion manifest alongside the bundle. Keep the public-event payload compact.
findings.compatibility: Single-source simple events should not require verbose assertion authoring for every field; deterministic defaults may bind all source-stated fields to the sole source while preserving explicit overrides for mixed-source cases.
findings.decision: Do not silently flatten mixed-source/derived claims in stable 1.0. Test a minimal assertion layer before promotion from draft.

findings.problem: An EVENT can occur on one date while a legally/criminologically material outcome occurs later. The current reviewed-bundle schema has event temporal fields and a short procedural summary but no structured outcome object with its own date and provenance.
required_semantics: relationship to offence instance where applicable
findings.rule: Occurrence temporal identity must remain source-faithful. A later death, recovery, loss amount, injury outcome or other consequence must not overwrite the occurrence date.
findings.candidate_implementation: Optional ALLEGATION_OUTCOME / EVENT_OUTCOME canonical entity, or equivalent structured reviewed-bundle section, kept separate from procedural history.
findings.decision: Test against at least one additional delayed-outcome case before stable 1.0.
